description: Collapse narratives turn uncertainty into inevitability and weaken action.
Dread is redirected toward enemies and used to weaken rights and democracy.
Innovation promises delay governance climate action and repair.
Continuous crisis communication produces exhaustion avoidance and distrust.
Hope is converted into branding while accountability remains weak.
Youth movements are celebrated but denied formal power and sustained support.
Actors invested in existing power resist repair-centered futures.
Disciplined hope weakens if institutions fail to produce visible accountability and repair.
